name: Showing Our Love For One Another
overview: Scripture commands believers to love one another with a love modeled after Christ's own sacrificial love, as emphasized in John 13:34-35 and John 15:12. This love is both a mark of true discipleship and the fulfillment of God's law, demonstrated by genuine care and honor toward others (Romans 12:10, Romans 13:10). The heart transformation necessary for this love begins with God creating a clean heart and renewing a right spirit within us (Psalms 51:10), enabling believers to live out this divine command authentically.
